crossRefs.note: I tell you, make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon, so that when you fail, they may receive you…
If you have not been faithful in that which is another’s, who will give you that which is your own?
not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.

translations.web: He said, ‘A hundred batos of oil.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.’
translations.bsb: ‘A hundred measures of olive oil,’ he answered. ‘Take your bill,’ said the manager, ‘sit down quickly, and write fifty.’
translations.kjv: And he said, An hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and sit down quickly, and write fifty.
translations.asv: And he said, A hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take thy bond, and sit down quickly and write fifty.
